name: structurizr-dsl
description: Syntax highlighting and language server support (diagnostics, hover, completion, go-to-definition, outline) for the Structurizr DSL, backed by structurizrx.

enumDescriptions: Use the structurizrx binary if one is found, otherwise the bundled WebAssembly server.
Only use the structurizrx binary; report an error if it isn't found.
Always use the bundled WebAssembly server, even if a binary is installed.
structurizrDsl.runtime.description: How to run the language server. The bundled WebAssembly build needs nothing installed; the native binary is faster and always matches your installed CLI.

structurizrDsl.serverPath.description: Path to the structurizrx binary. Leave empty to look it up on PATH (build it with `cargo build -p structurizr-cli` in the repo's rust/ directory). Ignored when structurizrDsl.runtime is "wasm".

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:wasm && npm run compile
